themes.title: Far-right push for 'national priority' policies
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties across Europe are intensifying demands for policies that prioritize citizens over immigrants, with Vox in Spain, Fratelli d'Italia/Lega in Italy, Rassemblement National in France, and Fidesz/Tisza in Hungary leading the charge. These parties frame immigration as a threat to national identity and social cohesion, pushing for stricter controls and preferential treatment for citizens in housing, employment, and welfare.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Demands 'national priority' in Andalusian budget negotiations, blocking investiture votes and pushing for stricter immigration controls.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Salvini calls for 'remigration' after a murder, later retracting when the killer is revealed as Italian. Meloni's government faces internal pressure over immigration policies.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Proposes a €40 billion climate plan without income restrictions, framed as a national priority to combat heatwaves and reduce dependency on foreign labor.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Opposes EU plans to restrict Ukrainian men's entry, citing protection for ethnic Hungarians in Transcarpathia. Implements water restrictions amid heatwave, framing it as a national security issue.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Criticizes local councils for promoting 'woke' policies, demanding stricter immigration controls and national preference in public services.

themes.title: Manuel Adorni scandal paralyzes Argentina's government
themes.blurb: The resignation of Argentina's Chief of Cabinet, Manuel Adorni, amid allegations of illicit enrichment and corruption has triggered a political crisis. The scandal has exposed internal fractures within La Libertad Avanza and prompted a cabinet reshuffle, with Diego Santilli taking over. The fallout has dominated domestic media and drawn international attention, particularly from right-wing allies.

countries.note: Adorni resigns amid illicit enrichment allegations, triggering a cabinet reshuffle and exposing internal fractures. The scandal dominates domestic media and political discourse.

countries.note: Italian right-wing media covers the scandal, highlighting its impact on Argentina's political stability and Milei's leadership.

countries.note: Spanish right-wing media reports on the scandal, emphasizing its implications for Argentina's economic reforms and political future.

themes.title: Right-wing parties target LGBTQ+ rights in Europe
themes.blurb: Right-wing and far-right parties across Europe are escalating attacks on LGBTQ+ rights, framing them as threats to traditional values. Vox in Spain, Fratelli d'Italia/Lega in Italy, Rassemblement National in France, and Reform UK in the UK are pushing for policies that restrict LGBTQ+ visibility, limit gender-affirming care, and oppose progressive legislation. These efforts are often tied to broader anti-immigration and nationalist agendas.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Opposes LGBTQ+ rights in local and regional governments, blocking Pride events and demanding the removal of LGBTQ+ symbols from public spaces.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Government delays or blocks progressive LGBTQ+ legislation, with Salvini and Meloni framing LGBTQ+ rights as divisive and unnatural.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Criticizes 'woke' policies and opposes LGBTQ+ visibility in public institutions, framing it as a threat to French cultural identity.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Demands bans on LGBTQ+ displays in libraries and public institutions, criticizing 'gender ideology' as harmful to children.

themes.title: AfD's constitutional crisis and far-right extremism
themes.blurb: Germany's Alternative für Deutschland (AfD) faces growing scrutiny over its ties to far-right extremism, with domestic intelligence agencies flagging nearly half its members as potential extremists. The party's rising popularity in polls and upcoming state elections has sparked debates over banning it, while its leaders push for closer ties with Russia and oppose EU policies. Similar concerns are echoed in other European countries, including France and Italy, where far-right parties are also gaining ground.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: AfD faces scrutiny over extremism ties, with intelligence agencies flagging 28,000 members as potential extremists. The party's rising popularity sparks debates over banning it.

countries.note: Faces EU fund misuse investigations, with raids on party offices and leaders. The party's extremist ties are scrutinized amid its rising popularity.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Government faces internal pressure from far-right figures like Vannacci, who challenge Meloni's leadership and push for more extreme policies.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Faces scrutiny over extremist ties and rhetoric, with leaders like Farage criticized for promoting divisive and anti-immigration policies.

themes.title: Poland-Ukraine tensions over historical narratives
themes.blurb: Poland and Ukraine are locked in a growing dispute over historical narratives, particularly the glorification of Ukrainian nationalist groups like the UPA and OUN, which Poland views as responsible for wartime atrocities. Polish officials, including President Karol Nawrocki and former PM Mateusz Morawiecki, have taken symbolic actions such as revoking honors and returning awards to protest Ukraine's policies. The tensions threaten to derail bilateral relations and Ukraine's EU accession talks.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Leads efforts to counter Ukraine's glorification of nationalist groups, with officials revoking honors and proposing legislation to ban UPA symbols.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: U.S. right-wing media amplifies Poland's stance, framing Ukraine's policies as provocative and aligned with Russian interests.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Hungarian government echoes Polish concerns, opposing Ukraine's nationalist policies and using them to justify opposition to Ukraine's EU accession.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: British right-wing media covers the dispute, emphasizing the historical grievances and their impact on European unity.
